## Description

Untrimmed `PLANE` exported and re-imported turns into `B_SPLINE_SURFACE_WITH_KNOTS` of degree (1,1) with 2x2 control net, comes back as trimmed plane with oversize natural rectangle relative to original. Affects feature recognition, mass properties, Booleans. CAD Exchanger and Spatial both call this "Geometry Simplification" / "Canonical Recognition".

## Reproducer recipe

STEP cylinder of radius 25.0 mm exported as `B_SPLINE_SURFACE_WITH_KNOTS` of degree (2,1) with rational weights; no `CYLINDRICAL_SURFACE` anywhere in file.

heal by analytic recovery — fit candidate primitive within tolerance, replace; reject canonicalization if recovered surface deviates beyond user-supplied tolerance.
